# Data sources and licensing

No external dataset is committed to this repository. Adapters download data on demand into the
gitignored `datasets/external/` directory and record a SHA-256 of what they used.

## Synthetic data (generated by this repository)

| Data | Generator | Namespace | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Novel-symbol task world (symbols, hidden rules, eval sets) | `hpe.tasks.SymbolWorld(seed)` | synthetic_simulation | repository licence (TBD, ADR-0007) |
| Agent societies, events, assessments | `hpe.world.World(config)` | synthetic_simulation | repository licence |
| Future Self demo users | created in the browser by the person using the demo; pseudonymous ids | user_private (local SQLite only) | n/a |

## External human data — license review (performed 2026-11-04)

| Dataset | Source | Terms found | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Psych-101 (Binz et al.) | `huggingface.co/datasets/marcelbinz/Psych-101` | Dataset card metadata `license: apache-2.0` and "Licensing Information: Apache License 2.0". Single file `prompts_training.jsonl` (859,179,475 bytes). Underlying experiments come from many original studies; the card asserts Apache-2.0 for the compiled transcripts. | **Usable** for research evaluation with attribution (cite arXiv:2410.20268). Re-distribution of extracts is not done; only derived metrics are committed. |
| HeartSteps V1 (Klasnja et al. 2019) | `github.com/klasnja/HeartStepsV1` | `LICENSE` file is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. README requests citation of Klasnja et al. (2019), *Annals of Behavioral Medicine* 53(6):573–582, doi:10.1093/abm/kay067. | **Usable** with attribution (candidate for Experiment 7, causal grounding from a micro-randomized trial). |
| DfE-DB (Yang, Spektor, Thoma, Hertwig & Wulff) | `github.com/dwulff/DfE-DB` | README: "The data is currently made available to data providers and will be shared openly upon article acceptance." No LICENSE file (HTTP 404 for `LICENSE`, `LICENSE.md`). | **Not usable yet.** Terms cannot be verified; revisit when an open licence is published. |

Rules: (1) never commit raw external data; (2) record dataset URL, retrieval date, file SHA-256 and
licence in the run manifest's `dataset_hashes`; (3) keep external data in the `external_dataset`
namespace; (4) no demographic subgroup analysis unless lawful, consented, and appropriate.
